## Working title

## Format

Feature, short, pilot, series, or limited series.

## Logline

One concrete dramatic sentence: protagonist, objective, resistance, and stakes.

## Source

Original, or list the relevant `books/<slug>/` source project(s).

## Dramatic engine

What keeps generating pressure after the premise is introduced? For a series, why can this produce distinct episodes rather than one repeated conflict?

## Audience and production reality

Who is this for? Note any meaningful scale, location, cast, period, VFX, or format constraints already known.

## Character pressure

Who drives the story, what do they want, and what makes the easy version impossible?

## Notes

Adaptation choices, collaborators, comparable tone, unresolved questions, or other constraints.
